title: How to Format Your Resume: Fonts, Templates & Layout (Teal Designer)
description:
Teal's Designer Mode gives you full control over the look and feel of your resume — templates, fonts, layout, and more. Watch how to choose a template, set your fonts and colors, reorder your sections, and fine-tune the formatting until your resume looks exactly the way you want.

A great resume isn't just about what it says — it's about how it reads at a glance. Designer Mode lets you browse one, two, and mixed-column templates, control your fonts and spacing, and decide how every detail displays, all without touching a line of formatting code.

transcript: [music] >> Teal's designer mode gives you full control over the look and feel of your resume. Templates, fonts, layout, and more. To get started, open a resume in Teal's resume builder and click the designer tab in the top toolbar. You'll see four sections: presentation, sections, settings, and advanced. We'll walk through each one. Presentation is where you choose your template. Browse one column, two column, or mixed column layouts. Teal Plus templates are marked with a banner in the top right corner. >> [music] >> Click any template to preview it, then click use template to apply it. >> [music] >> After selecting your template, scroll down in the designer to see the remaining presentation settings: font, line height, and accent color. You can also set your date format here. To show years only, select that option from the drop-down. Additional alignment options for dates, locations, and other details appear below. In the sections tab, drag and drop to reorder your resume sections, and click into any section title to rename it. For example, work experience could become relevant experience, or a volunteering and leadership section could be renamed additional experience. The settings tab gives you control over how your resume details are displayed. You can choose to hide locations entirely, or show them at the company level. Show work experience by lets you choose between grouping by position or by company. Useful depending on whether you want your titles or your employers to stand out. Similar display controls exist for education. Choose between an inline or stacked layout depending on how much space you want those details to take up. The advanced tab is for Teal Plus users and unlocks more granular controls: bullet style, separators, section spacing, title and content spacing, and more. That covers the designer in Teal's resume builder. Let us know if you have questions and enjoy customizing your resume. Like and subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
